fix: Ignore action/apply command completions and visibility results from an older PanelController generation, so a previous close cannot release newly reopened content.
regression_before_fix: Both delayed hide-response and delayed apply-visibility tests failed with active=false after reopening. Deterministic delayed completion reproduces the cleared body state; the natural timing was not consistently reproduced.
native_scope: Debug Windows host with embedded production Vite frontend, isolated data/profile, 300 synthetic texts and one 4K image. Production idle/suspend and shortcut handling retained; clipboard watcher disabled. Closing uses the actual page close/Escape handlers via test script; reopening uses one real Windows SendInput Ctrl+Alt+F10 chord per cycle. The second cycle holds the hide command response until after the first reopen completes.

cycles.close_path: Escape handler with delayed hide response

visual_verification: The normal reopen PrintWindow capture shows group buttons, records and image. The delayed-response capture was incomplete. A supplemental direct-screen capture was withheld because the isolated test window was not the foreground window; this is not counted as a visual pass.
limitations: Timings are diagnostics from a debug host, not a release performance comparison. No new memory benchmark. No macOS execution. Test callbacks and probes are confined to the ignored test copy and are absent from the production source and executable.
